summary:
[  edit  ]
The Revolve  SOP  revolves faces to create a surface of revolution. The revolution's direction and origin are represented by guide geometry that resembles a thick line with a cross hair at the centre. The cross hair represents the origin of the revolve as entered in the dialog and the stick represents the direction. Changing any of these parameters will cause the guide to change appropriately.
If the guide geometry is too distracting, you can disable it by entering the Viewport options dialog and clicking on the Guide geometry button so that it no longer appears indented. This procedure is global and will disable the guide geometry of other SOPs as well.

parameters.label: Connectivity
parameters.name: surftype
parameters.description: ⊞  - This option is used to select the type of surface, when using a Mesh  Primitive  Type.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Creates horizontal lines.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: Creates vertical lines.

parameters.label: Rows and Columns
parameters.name: rowcol
parameters.description: Both Rows and Columns. Looks like Quads in wire frame display, but all polygons are open (if the primitive type is polygon).

parameters.label: Triangles
parameters.name: triangles
parameters.description: Build the grid with Triangles.

parameters.label: Quadrilaterals
parameters.name: quads
parameters.description: Generates sides composed of quadrilaterals (default).

parameters.label: Alternating Triangles
parameters.name: alttriangles
parameters.description: Generates triangles that are opposed; similar to the Triangles option.

parameters.label: Origin
parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: ⊞  - Coordinates defining the origin of the revolution.

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: ⊞  - X, Y, and Z coordinates of the direction vector defining the direction of the revolve.

parameters.label: Convert Mesh to Polygons
parameters.name: polys
parameters.description: Changes the output mesh to consist of individual polygons.

parameters.label: Imperfect
parameters.name: imperfect
parameters.description: Applies to splines only. If selected, the results are approximated nonrational curves, otherwise they are perfect rational curves.

parameters.label: Revolve Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the revolve should be generated.

parameters.label: Closed
parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: An enclosed curve.

parameters.label: Open Arc
parameters.name: openarc
parameters.description: An open curve segment.

parameters.label: Closed Arc
parameters.name: closedarc
parameters.description: An open arc with connecting edges to the centre resembling a slice of pie.

parameters.label: Start End Angles
parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: ⊞  - The start and end angles of the revolve. A revolve will start at the beginning angle, and proceed towards the ending angle. If  Beginning  =  0  and  End  =  360  it will be fully revolved. Values greater than 360 are also valid.

parameters.label: Divisions
parameters.name: divs
parameters.description: Density of the resulting mesh surface.

parameters.label: Order
parameters.name: order
parameters.description: If a spline type is selected, it is built at this order.

parameters.label: End Caps
parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: If selected, it adds faceted end caps.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims

parameters.label: num_particles

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks

parameters.label: cook_end_time
